name: Party Wise Pending Order
query:
SELECT 
    `tabSales Order`.`name` AS "Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:110",
    `tabSales Order`.`transaction_date` AS "Date:Date:80",
    `tabCustomer Group`.`parent_customer_group` AS "Zone:Link/Customer Group:110",
    `tabSales Order`.`customer_group` AS "Devision:Data:80",
    `tabSales Order`.`customer` AS "Customer:Link/Customer:190",
    `tabSales Order`.`po_no` AS "Customer Order No:Data:100",
    `tabSales Order`.`po_date` AS "Customer Order Date:Date:100",

    
    SUM(
        `tabSales Order Item`.qty - IFNULL(`tabSales Order Item`.delivered_qty, 0)
    ) AS "Pending Qty:Float:100",

    
    SUM(
        `tabSales Order Item`.rate * 
        (`tabSales Order Item`.qty - IFNULL(`tabSales Order Item`.delivered_qty, 0))
    ) AS "Pending Amount:Float:120",

    
    (
        IFNULL(`tabSales Order`.per_delivered, 0)
        * IFNULL(`tabSales Order`.grand_total, 0)
        / 100
    ) AS "Delivered Amount:Currency:130",
    
    `tabSales Order`.status AS "Status:Data:140"

FROM
    `tabSales Order Item`
JOIN `tabSales Order`
    ON `tabSales Order Item`.`parent` = `tabSales Order`.`name`
JOIN `tabCustomer Group`
    ON `tabCustomer Group`.`customer_group_name` = `tabSales Order`.`customer_group`

WHERE
    `tabSales Order`.docstatus < 2
    AND `tabSales Order`.status NOT IN ("Stopped", "Closed")
    AND IFNULL(`tabSales Order Item`.delivered_qty,0) < IFNULL(`tabSales Order Item`.qty,0)

GROUP BY
    `tabSales Order`.`name`

ORDER BY
    `tabSales Order`.`name` DESC
